description: Manage Infinity IPAM using REST API.

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.description: IP Address for a reservation or a release.

parameters.name: network_address
parameters.description: Network address with CIDR format (for example 192.168.310.0).

parameters.name: network_family
parameters.description: Network family defined by Infinity, for example IPv4, IPv6 and Dual stack. Choices: "4" ← (default) "6" "dual"

parameters.name: network_location
parameters.description: The parent network ID for a given network. Default: -1

parameters.name: network_size
parameters.description: Network bitmask (for example 255.255.255.220 or CIDR format /26).

parameters.name: network_type
parameters.description: Network type defined by Infinity. Choices: "lan" ← (default) "shared_lan" "supernet"

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username to access Infinity. The user must have REST API privileges.

examples:
- hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  strategy: debug
  tasks:
    - name: Reserve network into Infinity IPAM
      community.general.infinity:
        server_ip: 80.75.107.12
        username: username
        password: password
        action: reserve_network
        network_name: reserve_new_ansible_network
        network_family: 4
        network_type: lan
        network_id: 1201
        network_size: /28
      register: infinity

return_values.name: ip_info
return_values.description:
When reserve next available IP address from a network, the IP address info is returned. Please note that the value is a string containing JSON data. Returned: success Sample: "{
 "address": "192.168.10.3",
 "hostname": "",
 "FQDN": "",
 "domainname": "",
 "id": 3229
}"

return_values.name: network_id
return_values.description: ID for a given network. Returned: success Sample: "1501"

return_values.name: network_info
return_values.description:
When reserving a LAN network from a Infinity supernet by providing network_size, the information about the reserved network is returned. Please note that the value is a string containing JSON data. Returned: success Sample: "{
 "network_address": "192.168.10.32/28",
 "network_family": "4",
 "network_id": 3102,
 "network_size": null,
 "description": null,
 "network_location": "3085",
 "ranges": {"id": 0, "name": null, "first_ip": null, "type": null, "last_ip": null},
 "network_type": "lan",
 "network_name": "'reserve_new_ansible_network'"
}"
